text:
Welcome to the LOTTE Hanoi Sky Observation Deck! Situated on the 65th floor of the Lotte Center Hanoi, this stunning deck offers breathtaking views of the city. You will have the unique opportunity to step onto glass floor areas that provide a thrilling perspective of the bustling streets below.

The entrance fee starts at 230,000 VND, but please note that prices may vary based on nationality, holidays, and special promotions. It's advisable to check for any bundles that may offer a better deal.

The observation deck is open daily from 9:30 AM to 10:30 PM, allowing you ample time to take in the beautiful scenery, especially as the sun sets over Hanoi. However, visibility can depend on the weather, so make sure to plan your visit accordingly for the best experience.

Remember that this location is not at Lotte Mall West Lake, so ensure you're heading to the correct site. Enjoy your visit and capture some unforgettable moments from one of Hanoi's highest viewpoints!
